description:
Refactor the `PricingCalculator.java` class in the `ecommerce-pricing` project to improve maintainability. 

1. Open `src/main/java/com/example/pricing/PricingCalculator.java`.
2. Extract the hardcoded tax rate (`1.0825`) to a private static final constant named `TAX_MULTIPLIER`.
3. Extract the hardcoded shipping cost (`15.00`) to a private static final constant named `SHIPPING_COST`.
4. Extract the hardcoded string `"PLATINUM"` inside the `calculateFinalPrice` method to a new method parameter named `targetTier`. This should update the method signature to accept three arguments.
5. Verify that the caller in `CheckoutService.java` has been automatically updated to pass `"PLATINUM"` (or the constant) as the new argument.
6. Ensure the project compiles successfully.
